page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Top: running head with page number at the top right. Main body: verse block, a rule, a heading, a verse epitaph with a large initial, a second heading, and a second verse epitaph. Foot: gathering signature at the bottom right.

main_text.l: pati, Muretum esse sibi ciuem iuffere Quirites,
Viuere nam potius qua debuit Vrbe cynædus?
O[?] Vanon à καθαρὸς, sed à κακὸς Duxit, pessima, nomen ominosum:
Illa, illa, est Catarina nunc sepulta,
Quid flas? quin propere hinc abis, Viator?
Aut, inquam, morere, aut abi, miselle.
TRes Erebi furias ne iam numerate, poëta,

l.i: Addita nā furiis est Catarina tribus:

main_text.l: Quod si tres Erebo demigrent forsitan
illa, Quarta Erebo fuerit pro tribus ista satis.

page.notes: The Greek words in the heading and first line are doubtful and may contain errors. The large initial letters O and T are uncertain. The page number 75 and the running head are read from the top of the scan.
